facts.fact: Financier YCELL Co. Ltd. (a company; its home country is not stated here) committed GMD 6.1 billion to modernise the network of GAMCEL, the state mobile operator, under a Share Investment and Network Modernization Agreement that also gives it an 80% equity stake. The report of 2026-07-10 says it was signed the day before.
